messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Service and Subscription Management" as it appears in the following examples.
['Unfortunately, we cannot authorize your payment for the next billing cycle of your subscription, Netflix was unable to receive a payment because the financial institution rejected the monthly charge.', 'As the Primary Contact, you must renew the service(s) listed below, or it will be deactivated and deleted.', 'If we do not hear from you within the next 24 hours, we will cancel your Online Transferred; service.', 'If this action was made by someone else, and you want to cancel the subscription, click on the link under the subscription specifications in this letter, and then change the password on your profile, perhaps it was stolen.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}

message.content: {"summary":"Renew subscriptions and maintain valid payment methods to prevent service deactivation; cancel unwanted subscriptions promptly and secure your account if activity seems unauthorized."}
